question: Should Discord Activity support continue from this older core-path branch, move to the newer broader Discord Activities PR, or restart as a Canvas-plugin-owned design with fail-closed Activity auth?
rationale: The unresolved choice crosses plugin ownership, Gateway authorization, token transport, operator config shape, and overlapping open PRs, so automation can identify defects but should not choose the permanent Activity security boundary.

options.title: Rebuild under Canvas plugin auth
options.body: Port the work to extensions/canvas and extensions/discord, require explicit Activity credentials, avoid URL tokens, bound fanout, and add live Discord proof before merge.

options.title: Continue through the newer PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/65205 as the working branch only after its similar security, compatibility, proof, and merge-state blockers are resolved.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Leave Discord Activities out of core until maintainers settle the security model and whether this belongs in the Canvas plugin or an external package.

recommendation.title: Rebuild under Canvas plugin auth
recommendation.body: Port the work to extensions/canvas and extensions/discord, require explicit Activity credentials, avoid URL tokens, bound fanout, and add live Discord proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and recent logs point most directly to `vincentkoc` on the active Canvas plugin route/config migration and Discord component surfaces this decision must preserve.
